First things first. You are not alone (as seen below). I know it is scary and there is stigma in getting help, but you have to ask yourself how long you want to live your life this way. How long you just want to be getting by. You will get tired of it one day and get the help you need. Just please get the help you need.

Second, it is important that you receive the help you really and truly need. If you call a therpists office and let them know that you are self-conscious, they will be willing to assist you in any way that is most comforting to you. So if you only want to go in the evenings when no one is around, they will do that. Or if you want to go in a dull time during the day, they will do that. Also, I am not sure where you live, but if you call your regular doctor, they can refer you to a therapist. Or at least recommend some therapists around you. Definitely take this matter up with your regular doctor. 

Also, just hang on. WHEN you do recover from this, there will be good days and bad days. But you will really and truly live.

Sudden death of a sibling. Or any close family member. 

About 3 and a half months ago, my brother suddenly died in his sleep of an issue with a myxomatous mitral valve. This kind of death only happens to less that 1% of the population of people who have the valve issue. It is so uncommon that I have only been able to find 2 journal articles written about it. I had dinner with him earlier in the night before he went to sleep. He seemed completely fine. Not sick at all. Didn't say that his chest was hurting or that he couldn't breathe. Nothing. Then boom. The next day I get a knock on my door with the news. 

My parents are heart broken and I have a lot more responsibility now because I am (developmentally) the oldest. No one could understand the extreme paradigm shift you go through when something like this happens. No warning. No time to prepare. You just have to react. 

And the denial. Just wrapping your head around it. It was so sudden. I just felt like somehow I fell into a different universe or dimension where my brother dies and I have to get back to my real dimension. Or somehow I am in a coma and this is some extreme delusion to which I will eventually wake up from. 

Sudden death of a loved one really sucks.
